findings.detail: Before snapshot is saved, but commit and readback stages have no exception receipt. Commit success followed by failed HTTP readback or TLS failure cannot be reconstructed from a durable original failure receipt; no stage or observed revision is retained on exception. This is material given actual TLS EOF in the previous study.
findings.recommended_fix: Write immutable intended local inventory/review/parent/prefix proposal before create_commit. Wrap mutation and post-readback stages to preserve sanitized stage/error type/message, known parent and returned revision if present, and explicitly uncertain outcome/no blind retry. Reraise after preserving evidence. Successful receipt should bind proposal and observed commit. Do not remove failed receipts.

findings.detail: SDK operations use mutable local file paths. Their bytes are checked against reviewed inventory before API parent fetch/SDK import and only again after remote mutation. A source change during this interval can upload unreviewed bytes and only be detected after publication.
findings.recommended_fix: Capture ordinary reviewed file bytes into bounded stable in-memory buffers/BytesIO or immutable fenced handles and construct SDK operations from those captured identities. Verify every captured bytes/SHA against review and perform a final original-file fence before committing; closing-fence consumed files/review on success. Keep additive parent guard.

publisher_verified_structure: Public fixed existing repository and separate additive prefix; prefix must be absent in current snapshot.
Current main parent is captured and explicitly supplied to HfApi.create_commit parent_commit; no merge, overwrite, deletion or automatic retry loop.
Upload candidates equal independently passed review release_files exactly, including metadata files.
Only CommitOperationAdd records under the new prefix.
Resulting immutable revision inventory must preserve all previous path/size/Git blob/LFS metadata and have exact old+new file count.
Every new file is downloaded at returned immutable revision, byte count and SHA checked, Git blob SHA computed, and local originals rehashed.
Public receipt correctly declares downloaded_numerical_replay false while local frozen replay precedes publication; no new training/default promotion claims.
qualification_limits: No actual HF inventory observed in this review; code handles all prior files rather than hardcoding3167, which preserves concurrent additions when using the captured current parent.
Prior identity preservation covers remote metadata identities, not fresh download of every prior object.
SDK transaction/dependency internals and network behavior are not independently executed or attested.
Default json.loads/assert usage assumes frozen curated root-generated inputs and ordinary non-optimized Python.
Final actual results, guardian/resource receipts, package/README and passed byte-inventory review remain required before invoking publisher.
No model, helper, test, lease, Git or HF execution performed by reviewer.
scope: Independent static review root-authored analyzer/publication preparation/publisher. No execution and no independent qualification of reviewer-authored cache/runner/equivalence.
